caption: The drawing features a detailed illustration of a woodworking tool, specifically a wooden hand plane with various attachments and screws. The main body of the plane is rendered in shades of brown, mimicking the appearance of varnished or oiled wood. Two large round wooden handles are attached to threaded rods that extend out from the right side of the tool, also shown in brown with wood grain detail. Metal components, including a blade that juts upward at an angle and is set into the body of the plane, are colored in darker tones, primarily gray and black, depicting the sheen and texture of metal. The screws show spiraled threads and are viewed from an angle, emphasizing their length and detail. The hand plane’s base is rectangular and has a carved groove on the side, and smaller wooden details are visible where the parts are joined together. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a technical line diagram in black ink showing a top and side view of the tool, and in the lower right corner, there is a smaller profile technical drawing, also in black ink. The background is an off-white or cream color, and the artist's signature, along with some numbers or notes, is written in small, neat handwriting below the main illustration.
title: Plane
